rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (missing shingles) with no third-party involvement is a straightforward property damage claim.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off last weekend. Estimated repair cost $400 with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Low-severity claim ready for roofer quote coordination.

case_facts.description: wind blew off four shingles from roof overhang
